correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact 2n×2n Laplacian, two explicitly invertible integer coordinate changes isolate one free generator, one cyclic factor of order (n-1+k)(n-2+2k), and n-2 copies of the same full-rank 2×2 integral matrix. Its first Smith entry is gcd(n,k-1), and the determinant is n(n-2+2k). This proves the group for all n>=3,k>=0, including k=0. The independent eigenvalue calculation verifies the resulting spanning-tree product. Direct full reduced-Laplacian Smith forms matched 90 cases; pure-integer matrix-tree determinants matched 88 cases. These finite checks are supplementary only.
